what: Lee Sharks's rulings on the room reading of 2026-10-16 (RULINGS-2026-10-16.md), as seats. Folded into data/hexagon-seats.json by scripts/build_hexagon_seats.py as source 'ruled 2026-10-16'. A ruled primary seat replaces the reader's primary flag on that record; no seat is removed except the four Encyclotron seats moved from R:r.15 to R:r.05.
ruling: current tethers can keep their place but gw should be standard going forward, and that should link to machinemediation - ideally there should be a way for others to submit continuity tethers there. but thats later. the plato aristotle and aristotle theophrastus authorship lines should go with the restored academy. thats provenanced in cha or should be. new human cohort anchors and heteronym and dodecad registry go with the secret name / pearl armature. umbml was conceived as a meta structure of cha. all the logotic programming / hacking materials go with umbml, and logotic programming constitutes cha - if you read the umbml provenance it should make that clear, and yes its documents should be seated in relation to cha and navigable. encyclotron should go with semantic economy. and i am fine with disagreements persisting. the index should also link outward to the fleet, blog, etc. we can add the low confidence ones to the index, just keep them marked low confidence for later adjudication.

T:UMBML.note: Logotic Programming constitutes the Hexagon (ruled 2026-10-16). The charter (#7) names UMBML the technical/operational research institution within the NH-OS framework, and the Logotic Foundation Triad (#357) binds it to Symbolon Architecture (#359) and the Talos Morrow provenance (#358). The interface's canonical data names Logotic Programming a founded discipline of the Hexagon (DISC-09, institution UMBML) and defines it among the Hexagon's own units (DEF-05, Logotic Programming — Version Table, §I of the Space Ark).
T:UMBML.clause: logotic programming constitutes cha - if you read the umbml provenance it should make that clear
